description: The context of a product written as facts: SEO, personalization, data freshness, teams, deploy needs, clients and business complexity.
An explicit condition that maps a fact of the briefing to an option in one layer, ordered from the most demanding requirement to the simplest default.
The cheapest option that satisfies every requirement of the briefing. Anything stronger must be justified by a fact, not by fashion.
Filling each route's missing fields from the briefing so every route answers the same questions before its rendering is chosen.
A choice paired with its reason, written as `<subject>: <choice> because <why>`. It is the seed of an ADR.
